_comment: Full regression run configuration. Use before major releases or after large code merges.
_run_name_comment: Replace {{VERSION}} with release number (e.g. 12.28.5) and {{DATE}} with today's date.
_test_type_filter_comment: Options: smoke | regression | functional | security | performance | negative
_target_modules_comment: Full regression covers ALL modules. Remove any not active in your environment.

source_directories._comment: All Orders controllers — includes orders, items, checkout, approvals, workflow
All Reports controllers — includes report CRUD, sharing, attachments
All Inventory controllers — includes stock counts, adjustments, transfers
Root controllers — Home, Account, Search, GraphQL, etc.

_source_directories_comment: Analyze entire directories instead of individual files. All .cs files in each dir will be processed.
_dry_run_comment: Set to false when ready to push to Jira. ALWAYS preview first with dry_run=true.
_output_file_comment: Output file path. Replace {{VERSION}} and {{DATE}} before running.
_chunk_size_comment: Lines per chunk. Large controllers like OrdersController.cs (25KB) will be split automatically.
_push_to_xray_comment: Set to true to push to Xray. Requires XRAY_CLIENT_ID and XRAY_CLIENT_SECRET in .env.
_jira_labels_comment: Labels applied to every Jira issue in this regression run.
_skip_files_comment: Skip files whose names contain these strings — they're rarely testable.
_min_confidence_to_push_comment: Only push test cases with confidence_score >= this value. Lower scores go to needs_review.
